description: This endpoint bulk updates a batch of Actual Production Quantities (APQ).

id.description: Unique identifier for this actual production quantity record.

description.description: Free-text note describing work performed or conditions affecting the production quantity entry.

earned_production_quantity_id.description: The ID of the associated Earned Production Quantity in the Production Tracking system

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure for the quantity value, such as square feet (Sf) or linear feet (Lf). Inherited from the associated cost code.

quantity.description: Numeric amount of work installed, measured in the associated unit_of_measure.

timesheet_id.description: Identifier of the timesheet this production quantity is linked to. When set, the timesheet's date is used for the production quantity regardless of the date field.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

date.description: Date the work was performed, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Ignored when timesheet_id is provided, because the timesheet's date takes precedence.

approval_status.description: The approval status of the Actual Production Quantity

rejection_reason.description: Free-form note describing why the Actual Production Quantity was rejected

attachments.description: Files attached to the Actual Production Quantity. Add attachments on create or update with `actual_production_quantity[prostore_file_ids]`, `[upload_ids]`, `[image_ids]`, `[drawing_revision_ids]`, ...

403.description: User does not have permission to update Actual Production Quantities

id.description: Existing identifier of the actual production quantity to update.

description.description: Free-text note describing work performed or conditions affecting this production quantity entry.

quantity.description: Numeric amount of work installed, measured in the cost code's unit of measure.

date.description: The date the Actual Production Quantity was performed

crew_id.description: Identifier of the crew to associate with this production quantity.

location_id.description: Identifier of the project location where the work was performed.

prostore_file_ids.description: Prostore Files to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

upload_ids.description: The specified array of upload ids is saved as Actual Production Quantity attachments.

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the Actual Production Quantity

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the Actual Production Quantity
